name: I Want To Know
source:
Chris Mattix lives a lonely life up in Alaska when he runs afoul of a group of classmates turned gang members, which threatens his friendship with former leader Tyler Darden.  Complicating matters is mysterious old man Clemson Gault who might not even be human.

[From [url=https://epyc-games.itch.io/i-want-to-know]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克里斯·马蒂克斯在阿拉斯加过着孤独的生活，他与一群变成帮派成员的同学发生了冲突，这威胁到了他与前领导人泰勒·达顿的友谊。神秘的老人克莱姆森·高特（Clemson Gault）使事情变得更加复杂，他甚至可能不是人类。

[来自[url=https://epyc-games.itch.io/i-want-to-know]Itch.io[/url]]
